name: Mabon
subtitle: Rescued Huntmaster
description: Veil and Resist the elements as you Hunt your Foes in the Wilds of Avalon.
lore: Son of a goddess, Mabon ap Modron is not merely a knight of King Arthur’s Round Table but the greatest tracker in their ranks. Few creatures exist, mundane or supernatural, that he cannot hunt down. Mabon recently departed Camelot on a hunt he considers vital, yet he has told none what he seeks—or what dire consequence he fears should he fail.
